title: Vacuum and transaction ID age
summary: Vacuum supports tuple reuse, visibility and transaction-ID freeze safety. Database frozen-XID age is a useful explicit contract; dead-tuple estimates alone do not establish bloat or a required remediation.
checks: Compare frozen-XID age with a chosen limit and approved maintenance evidence.
limitations: This read-only check neither vacuums nor diagnoses every table.
